info.title: PowerShift AI API
info.description: FastAPI owner-scoped API with deterministic arithmetic and optional local-only Ollama label extraction. Hosted image processing is disabled. Model accuracy and deployment readiness require separate verification.

servers.description: Relative deployment-independent target API; no host or deployment is selected.

x-contract-status: M7 local-only scan implementation; production vision model not selected.
x-authentication-gate: Verified RS256 bearer JWT from configured issuer/API audience required for all operations except GET /api/status. Managed vendor remains selectable by configuration.
x-image-retention-gate: Images are memory-only and sanitized before local processing. Candidates, evidence and consent remain in owned profile records until operator profile/account deletion. No automatic purge. Hosted processing is not approved.

get.description: Public target contract. imageScanningConfigured is a configuration flag, not proof of a live/verified provider or production readiness. No credentials, model name, keys, internal topology, or budget details are returned.

post.description: Requires explicit review of final submitted values. Confirmed incomplete appliances may be saved but are excluded from energy totals. AI receipts must be bound to the same principal/profile and may be consumed only once; same-body idempotent retries return the original successful resource while it exists. After appliance deletion the durable key remains: identical replay returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND and never recreates it; changed-body replay remains 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Server composes provenance from original scan candidates and final customer fields. No client-provided totals, owner IDs, source_status or timestamps. No raw image retention/storage mechanism is selected.

patch.summary: Edit and reconfirm an owned appliance.
patch.description: Validate version and ownership, merge allowed changes, require explicit confirmation of all resulting fields, and revalidate complete merged state atomically. Null clears a nullable input and may make the record incomplete. Recompute derived energy; preserve original evidence in server-composed provenance. AI linkage requirements apply to final source state. New AI source/candidate consumption must obey receipt/profile/principal isolation; existing same-receipt linkage may be preserved for later manual corrections of that appliance.

post.summary: Calculate and save an immutable owned report snapshot.
post.description: Server loads owned persisted appliances and produces one consistent immutable input snapshot, preserving each appliance's confirmation, version and provenance. No client appliances or totals accepted. Calculation input is projected from saved records; recompute exactly server-side. Idempotent replay returns the original snapshot even if the current profile/appliances have changed. Persistence, ownership and retention are design gates; no deployed database or cloud account is implied.

get.summary: Export an immutable owned report as CSV.
get.description: Export saved report inputs/results, preserving the same calculation values and incomplete-record information shown by the report. text/csv success; application/json stable errors. Exact column order: report_id,estimate,appliance_id,name,quantity,rated_watts,hours_per_day,effective_load_percent,source_method,source_status,calculation_status,daily_kwh,period_days,period_kwh,rate_ngn_per_kwh,tariff_provenance,grid_equivalent_cost_ngn,cost_basis,assumptions,exclusion_codes. estimate is literal true. cost_basis is grid_equivalent when tariff is present, otherwise empty. assumptions repeats the saved report assumptions joined with semicolons. Unknown numeric inputs and ineligible row energy/cost cells are empty; retain known input values. Use UTF-8, correct CSV quoting and spreadsheet-formula escaping of user-controlled text without modifying saved domain values. CSV is implemented from the immutable saved snapshot. The authenticated React report view supplies print-friendly reporting.

Quantity.description: Strict JSON integer >= 1 within JavaScript's exact integer range. Boolean and numeric-string coercion is forbidden.

anyOf.description: Customer-provided/confirmed real power in W. Never infer from appearance or silently substitute VA. No numeric default.
Customer estimate, including a valid explicit zero. No numeric default.
Explicit customer assumption. Missing/null remains incomplete until the user supplies a value; never silently substitute 100%.
Customer-supplied NGN per kWh; explicit zero is valid. Null means no cost scenario. Never infer a tariff.

EnergyDecimal.description: Nonnegative kWh serialized as a fixed six-decimal string. Exact decimal arithmetic with no intermediate rounding; ROUND_HALF_UP at presentation only.

MoneyDecimal.description: Nonnegative NGN serialized as a fixed two-decimal string. Calculated from unrounded energy and tariff; ROUND_HALF_UP at presentation only.

SourceMethod.description: M2 estimated-appliance sources only. measured is reserved for a future, separate measurement domain and is not accepted.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the field, or an empty string for the complete object. No rejected values appear in errors.

Error.description: Stable error envelope for application-controlled failures. Message text is informational; clients branch on codes. Never expose secrets, images, provider output, sensitive rejected inputs, or stack traces.

imageScanningConfigured.description: Configuration capability flag only; true is not evidence of provider reachability, verified extraction, or launch readiness.

ProfileCreate.description: Idempotency scope: verified principal + create-profile operation. Repeating the same validated body returns the existing resource with 200; reuse with a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

FieldProvenance.description: Server-composed provenance. Preserve original visible label evidence even after customer corrections; source_notes do not replace that evidence. Null fields still have provenance and explanations when available.

FieldProvenanceMap.description: Required per-field map composed by the server. quantity, hours_per_day and effective_load_percent use user_entry, never label extraction. catalogue_name applies only to name. Field/source consistency is validated semantically.

ApplianceCreate.description: All fields are explicit; unknown/server-controlled fields are rejected. Null numeric values are intentionally incomplete, not zero/defaults. confirmation:true acknowledges review of all final submitted values; the server sets confirmed status/timestamps. AI source requires a principal/profile-linked unexpired unused scan receipt. Manual/document source requires null scan_id. The catalogue may supply a name only. Idempotency is scoped to principal + operation + profile; replay returns 200 even if its consumed scan is no longer usable, while different payload reuse returns 409.

AppliancePatch.description: Partial edit, requiring a current version and affirmative review of the final merged values. At least one mutable field is required. Apply atomically; all omitted mutable fields retain their values. Null deliberately clears a nullable value. Validate final source_method/scan_id/provenance consistency after merge. Server updates confirmation and provenance; stale version is 409 STALE_VERSION. No client_request_id or server-derived fields accepted.

ApplianceRead.description: Confirmed estimated appliance, which may still be incomplete. Calculated values are server-derived. Eligible iff the confirmed numeric inputs are complete and valid; otherwise daily energy is null. Confirmation means customer review, not measurement or independent verification. Owner identity is never accepted from the client.

UploadConsent.description: Explicit acknowledgement of the versioned upload notice. Notice wording and retention/provider terms require approval before live uploads; this schema does not approve a privacy policy.

imageDataUrl.description: One nonempty base64 JPEG, PNG or WebP data URL. Regex is structural only: server must validate base64, decoded bytes, actual MIME/content, image decoding and configured limits. Malformed/unsupported decoded image is 400 INVALID_IMAGE; configured size violation is 400 IMAGE_TOO_LARGE.

ScanRequest.description: Local-only configurable Ollama extraction. Never creates an appliance. Requires explicit versioned local-processing consent, validated JPEG/PNG/WebP, owned profile and configured usage limits. Invalid images return 400, oversized HTTP bodies 413, invalid consent fields 422, unavailable local model 503, invalid output 502 and timeout 504. Candidate receipt is owner-scoped, expires after the configured interval, and is consumed only by a separate confirmed appliance write. Hosted processing is disabled.

anyOf.description: Visible unambiguous W rating only. Missing, VA-only or conflicting ratings return null.
Visible label energy evidence only, kept distinct from modeled daily energy and actual measured consumption. Never automatically mapped to calculated_daily_kwh or an energy record.

ScanCandidate.description: Candidates contain visible evidence only. All missing/ambiguous fields are null, not empty strings, zero or guesses. Keep VA/current/voltage evidence explicit in notes/evidence; no automatic VA to W conversion. Never extract usage quantity, runtime or load percentage from a rating label.

ScanResponse.description: Extraction only: creates no appliance and cannot confirm any value. scan_id is an opaque candidate receipt linked to the principal and profile; expiry is configured candidate validity, not an image-retention commitment. Receipt persistence/security mechanism and privacy policy must be approved before live integration. All candidates remain editable before an explicit appliance write.

CalculationInputRow.description: Inline preview input. Client-supplied confirmation status is a preview assertion only, never persisted evidence of confirmation or ownership. Measured readings belong to a separate future domain.

appliances.description: IDs must be unique within the request (semantic validation). An empty array is valid and produces null totals with NO_ELIGIBLE_RECORDS.

CalculationRequest.description: Stateless deterministic preview only; it writes no appliance or report. All JSON numeric inputs must be finite numbers, never booleans or numeric strings. Decimal parsing must preserve transmitted decimal values. Invalid HTTP input is an atomic 422, not a partially successful calculation.

input_index.description: Zero-based input position. Output order matches input order; each row is correlated without inventing an identifier.

id.description: Original valid input UUID, or null when a legacy/internal malformed row has no valid UUID. Every valid HTTP input preserves its original UUID. Never invent replacement IDs.

CalculationRowResult.description: Exclusive status precedence: invalid > unconfirmed > incomplete > eligible. Noneligible rows have null energy and are excluded from totals; eligible rows have nonnull energy, including 0.000000 when runtime is zero. invalid is available to the pure engine for legacy/internal malformed input; use input_index and nullable id to correlate such rows without invented identifiers. Valid HTTP inputs preserve the original UUID and output order matches input order. Schema-invalid HTTP requests fail atomically with 422.

CalculationCounts.description: Exclusive category counts sum to total and agree with row statuses.

CalculationTotals.description: Sum eligible rows using exact unrounded values, then format totals once. No eligible rows => all totals null. At least one eligible row => energy nonnull, even if zero. Cost is nonnull only when there is an eligible row and tariff is nonnull; explicit zero tariff yields 0.00. Cost is a hypothetical all-grid scenario, never an actual mixed-source bill or savings claim.

tariff_provenance.description: Server-derived source: user_input iff rate_ngn_per_kwh is nonnull, including zero; null iff tariff is null. This records customer input, not verified bill evidence. Requests cannot assert this output field.

CalculationResponse.description: Authoritative deterministic formula: quantity * rated_watts * hours_per_day * effective_load_percent / 100 / 1000; period energy = daily energy * period_days. No implicit defaults. Exact decimal calculations, no intermediate rounding, ROUND_HALF_UP only when serializing fixed6/fixed2 strings. If an operation cannot represent a value under its documented implementation limits, reject the entire request with 422 CALCULATION_OUT_OF_RANGE; never clamp/default. Rounded rows may not sum visually to the independently rounded total; disclose with ROUNDING_APPLIED when applicable. Display results as estimates, with rated-power and customer-usage assumptions.

ReportCreate.description: Server loads the owned profile's persisted confirmed appliance inputs, computes deterministically, and saves an immutable report snapshot. No inline appliances, client totals, or owner fields are accepted. Idempotency scope: principal + create-report operation + profile; same body replay returns 200 existing snapshot, conflicting reuse returns 409. Report persistence/privacy approval remains an implementation gate.

tariff_provenance.description: Server-derived source: user_input iff the saved rate_ngn_per_kwh is nonnull, including zero; null iff tariff is null. Must agree with calculation.tariff_provenance. No independent bill verification is claimed.

ReportInputSnapshot.description: Immutable server-loaded full appliance snapshot, preserving versions, provenance, confirmed_at and values despite later edits/deletions. calculation rows are a projection of these saved inputs; this snapshot never accepts client-provided derived totals.

ReportRead.description: Immutable report. Calculation input values must agree with the input snapshot and only use eligible confirmed rows. Persisting a report is not a claim that its estimates are measured, that deployment exists, or that a retention policy has been approved.
